newsitem.title: FRANCE: Broker cuts Air Liquide, Lyonnaise recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Broker cuts Air Liquide, Lyonnaise recommendation.

text.p: Paris brokerage SGE Delahaye changed to "under-perform" from "neutral" its recommendation on the shares of Air Liquide and Lyonnaise des Eaux, market operators said on Friday.
The brokerage has already revised downwards its earnings estimate for Air Liquide and plans to do so for Lyonnaise.
The decisions are linked to disappointing first-half results for Air Liquide and lack of prospects for a substantial upturn for Lyonnaise by the end of the year.
Air Liquide was off 13 francs to 805 francs in a volume of 196,233 shares and Lyonnaise down 6.1 francs to 453.1 francs with 131,771 shares exchanged at 1422 GMT.
